cards.base: z-card bg-surface border border-border rounded-[var(--radius-xl)] shadow-sm
cards.glass: z-card bg-surface/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-border/20 rounded-[var(--radius-xl)] shadow-premium

buttons.base: z-btn inline-flex items-center justify-center px-[var(--space-6)] py-[var(--space-3)] rounded-[var(--radius-md)] font-[var(--font-semibold)] transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2
buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-sm hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: bg-surface-elevated text-foreground border border-border/50 hover:bg-muted/10 active:scale-[0.98]

inputs.base: z-input w-full bg-surface border border-[var(--color-border)] hover:border-[var(--color-border-strong)] rounded-[var(--radius-md)] px-[var(--space-4)] py-[var(--space-3)] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary outline-none transition-all duration-200

app.root: h-screen flex flex-col bg-background text-foreground overflow-hidden min-w-[320px]
app.header: z-shell__header h-16 border-b border-border bg-surface/80 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-[var(--z-header)]

layout.header: flex justify-between items-end border-b border-[var(--color-border)] pb-[var(--space-8)]

error.container: p-[var(--space-10)] bg-red-500/[var(--alpha-8)] border border-red-500/[var(--alpha-12)] rounded-[var(--radius-xl)] text-center animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-[var(--motion-medium)]
error.title: text-xl font-[var(--font-black)] text-red-500 mb-[var(--space-2)]

loading.container: flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[400px] gap-[var(--space-4)]
loading.spinner: w-12 h-12 border-4 border-primary/[var(--alpha-12)] border-t-primary rounded-full animate-spin
loading.text: text-[var(--text-sm)] font-[var(--font-medium)] text-muted-foreground animate-pulse tracking-[var(--tracking-widest)] uppercase

empty.container: py-[var(--space-20)] text-center border-2 border-dashed border-border/40 rounded-[var(--radius-2xl)]
empty.title: text-lg font-[var(--font-bold)] text-foreground/40 mb-[var(--space-2)]
